# October 2026 patch release: notation

Current: `v1.3.4-monthly-test.202610`  
Proposed: `v1.3.5-manual-review.20261018`

## Changes

The approved scope merges these Dependabot PRs, adopts the planned library releases, and cuts a patch release:

- [#25](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/25): pflag 1.0.9 to 1.0.10, x/term 0.46.0 to 0.47.0, ORAS 2.6.2 to 2.6.3, E2E Ginkgo 2.33.0 to 2.33.1, Gomega 1.40.0 to 1.44.0, and transitive dependency updates.
- [#22](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/22): codecov-action 5.4.2 to 7.1.1.
- [#21](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/21): stale 9.1.0 to 11.0.0.
- [#20](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/20): checkout 4.2.2 to 7.0.1.
- [#19](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/19): add-to-project 1.0.2 to 2.0.0.
- [#18](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/pull/18): codeql-action 4.38.2 to 4.38.3.

Dependencies: [yizha1/notation-core-go#20](https://github.com/yizha1/notation-core-go/issues/20) and [yizha1/notation-go#16](https://github.com/yizha1/notation-go/issues/16).

## Overall status

The [scope is approved](https://github.com/yizha1/notation/issues/26#issuecomment-6260449311). Core's qualified draft awaits review and publication. Go and CLI are blocked on their linked dependencies; no Go or CLI draft exists.

Each repository's issue holds its own changes, errors, blockers, and draft-ready notification. Maintainers publish each release manually, in dependency order.
